frame_length: four-byte unsigned big-endian UTF8 payload length
request_sequence: strictly contiguous; starts at one; no retry after uncertain I/O
json: compact; no duplicate decoded keys; canonical JSON string escaping; exact integer tokens only; no unknown fields
continuous_scalars: only a closed {f64: sixteen lowercase hexadecimal IEEE754 binary64 big-endian bit digits} in the typed continuous slots; reject nonfinite patterns; preserve negative zero 8000000000000000
integer_scalars: nonnegative safe integer tokens; reject booleans, fractions and negative zero
chunk_encoding: standard canonical padded base64; raw length <=32768; exact SHA-256
process_boundary: private CREBAIN child only; no peer endpoint or executable/path/URL fields
parent_eof: retire owned environment; return no complete terminal success on unresolved cleanup
external_ncp_transport: unchanged generic SDK; only Rust endpoint is externally exposed
